_comment: Pre-yield git evidence is the local final head_sha; host branch capture follows a successful child result. All completion modes require REPORTED, reviewer handoff, and release. An open linked escalation pauses completion without changing ownership; the architect reconciles durable work after the escalation closes. Routing is enforced at the write seam, while handoff uses the agent:reviewer label. Git work is judged as work, not as presence: the head must have moved off the bead's base (metadata.base_sha, else the run epic's) and REPORTED must name a changed path, unless the worker wrote NOTE no-change: <reason> to say the task needed no edit. A base nobody recorded leaves the head comparison unknown, which fails open.

completion.require: comment.REPORTED names a path or comment.NOTE no-change
